title: On the problem of generalized measures: an impossibility result
summary: This paper investigates the problem of extending measure theory to non-separable structures, from generalized descriptive set theory to a broader class of spaces beyond this framework. While various notions, such as the ideal of measure zero sets, have been generalized, the question of whether a satisfactory notion of $λ^+$-measure could be defined in generalized descriptive set theory has remained open.
